quarterly_data.quarter: Amgen Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference 2026 (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Thomas Dittrich and SVP Global Marketing and Access Kaveh on IMDELLTRA: the Phase III DeLLphi-305 study of IMDELLTRA plus durvalumab as first-line maintenance in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer showed statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in overall survival, progression-free survival and objective response rate versus durvalumab alone, with U.S. monitoring in the study reduced to one to two hours. The current label requires 22 hours of monitoring on the first two doses; Europe has already cut this to a six to eight hour requirement and Amgen has filed in the U.S., with a PDUFA date set, for a similar reduction; over 2,000 sites use IMDELLTRA actively.
quarterly_data.figure: 22 hours of monitoring cut to six to eight hours in Europe; one to two hours in DeLLphi-305

quarterly_data.quarter: Amgen Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference 2026 (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Thomas Dittrich, regulatory and data milestones: TEZSPIRE had positive top-line Phase III results in eosinophilic esophagitis (more than 470,000 people in the U.S.); the Phase III OPTIC-J study of TEPEZZA in Japanese thyroid eye disease patients met both primary endpoints with no new safety findings (announced at the conference); the Phase III study of ABP 234, the KEYTRUDA biosimilar candidate, met primary and secondary endpoints, with a regulatory submission planned in the second half of this year; the BLA for ABP 206, the OPDIVO biosimilar candidate, has been submitted and accepted, with an FDA action expected by end of the year. Chief Medical Officer Paul Burton: the two Phase III Sjogren's studies of dazodalibep read out 'in the coming months' and can probably stand on their own; a CIDP trial of UPLIZNA starts very soon and the autoimmune hepatitis trial is enrolling.

quarterly_data.quarter: Amgen Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference 2026 (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SVP Global Marketing and Access Kaveh on Repatha: according to IQVIA data Repatha passed 15,000 and then 16,000 new patients per week at the end of August, with the inflection after the FOURIER-OLE primary-prevention data coming from both primary care and cardiology; EU approval for primary prevention came at the end of August and that launch is starting; at least 100 million people are not at guideline-based LDL despite standard therapy and PCSK9 penetration is still in the low to mid-single digits, so oral PCSK9 entrants are growing the market faster than taking share. Chief Medical Officer Paul Burton: the American Academy of Family Physicians now endorses the ACC/AHA multi-society lipid guideline. Kaveh: in gMG about half of UPLIZNA patient volume comes from naive patients and half from switches.
quarterly_data.figure: 16,000 new Repatha patients per week at the end of August

quarterly_data.quarter: Amgen Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference 2026 (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chief Medical Officer Paul Burton on MariTide: the three-step dose escalation now used in Phase III was tested in a Phase III study and meaningfully improves nausea and vomiting rates; Phase II showed 20% weight loss and an 11 millimeters of mercury reduction in blood pressure, with every 8-week or even quarterly dosing possible. Kaveh: in the U.S. more patients have started and stopped GLP-1s than are on them, and MariTide at as few as 4 to 6 doses per year is studied for maintenance in two long-term extensions plus a switch study. CFO Thomas Dittrich: Amgen would be prepared to flex margins slightly downwards (as it has from peaks in the 50s) to invest behind drivers that create long-term cash-on-cash value, with productivity, process streamlining and AI freeing funds; business development needs strategic fit, positive cash returns, Amgen as the best owner and prompt integration, with flexible deal structures from licensing to M&A, and is not needed to fill a gap.
quarterly_data.figure: 20% weight loss in Phase II; 11 millimeters of mercury blood pressure reduction
